# Old Vault to Ultimate Wiki Migration

## Main rule
Do not copy the old vault wholesale.
Mine it, classify it, translate it, and re-home it.

## Migration buckets
### Keep nearly as-is
- durable research/reference docs
- system architecture notes still true
- useful agent-learning notes
- session-summary formats worth preserving

### Translate into new language
- vault -> wiki/workspace substrate
- note -> page/object page/artifact
- MOC -> hub/index/entrypoint
- memory file -> chronicle/recall/memory object

### Distill / merge
- duplicated system docs
- overlapping project notes
- stale setup files
- parallel README/index notes

### Archive as lineage
- historically useful but no longer active structures
- dead conventions that still explain system evolution

## Outcome
A cleaner, stronger system that keeps the old vault's power without dragging all of its shape forward unchanged.
